newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian Oct net financing surplus 6.5 bln Bfr.
newsitem.headline: Belgian Oct net financing surplus 6.5 bln Bfr.

text.p: The Belgian Treasury recorded a federal net financing surplus of 6.5 billion francs in October versus a 9.7 billion shortfall in the year-ago month, the Finance and Budget Ministries said in a statement on Wednesday.

The cumulative net financing requirement for the first 10 months of 1996 totalled 324.8 billion francs, it added. This compared to a financing requirement of 358.5 billion in the first 10 months of 1995.
